questions.official_guidance: Answer ‘Yes’ if a random component was used in the sequence generation process. Examples include computer-generated random numbers; reference to a random number table; coin tossing; shuffling cards or envelopes; throwing dice; or drawing lots. Answer ‘No’ if no random element was used in generating the allocation sequence or the sequence is predictable. Answer ‘No information’ if the only information about randomization methods is a statement that the study is randomized.

39|BACKGROUND
40|Androgen-deprivation therapy (ADT) has been the backbone of treatment for
41|metastatic prostate cancer since the 1940s. We assessed whether concomitant
42|treatment with ADT plus docetaxel would result in longer overall survival than that
43|with ADT alone.
44|METHODS
45|We assigned men with metastatic, hormone-sensitive prostate cancer to receive
46|either ADT plus docetaxel (at a dose of 75 mg per square meter of body-surface
47|area every 3 weeks for six cycles) or ADT alone. The primary objective was to test
48|the hypothesis that the median overall survival would be 33.3% longer among
49|patients receiving docetaxel added to ADT early during therapy than among pa-
50|tients receiving ADT alone.
51|RESULTS
52|A total of 790 patients (median age, 63 years) underwent randomization. After a
53|median follow-up of 28.9 months, the median overall survival was 13.6 months
54|longer with ADT plus docetaxel (combination therapy) than with ADT alone (57.6
55|months vs. 44.0 months; hazard ratio for death in the combination group, 0.61;
56|95% confidence interval [CI], 0.47 to 0.80; P<0.001). The median time to bio-
57|chemical, symptomatic, or radiographic progression was 20.2 months in the com-
58|bination group, as compared with 11.7 months in the ADT-alone group (hazard
59|ratio, 0.61; 95% CI, 0.51 to 0.72; P<0.001). The rate of a prostate-specific antigen
60|level of less than 0.2 ng per milliliter at 12 months was 27.7% in the combination
61|group versus 16.8% in the ADT-alone group (P<0.001). In the combination group,
62|the rate of grade 3 or 4 febrile neutropenia was 6.2%, the rate of grade 3 or 4
63|infection with neutropenia was 2.3%, and the rate of grade 3 sensory neuropathy
64|and of grade 3 motor neuropathy was 0.5%.
65|CONCLUSIONS
66|Six cycles of docetaxel at the beginning of ADT for metastatic prostate cancer re-
67|sulted in significantly longer overall survival than that with ADT alone. (Funded by
68|the National Cancer Institute and others; ClinicalTrials.gov number, NCT00309985.)

assigned to ADT alone were seen every 3 months.

Randomization and Stratification
Randomization will be performed with the following stratifications: 1) age: ≥ 70
vs. < 70; 2) ECOG PS: 0-1 vs. 2; 3) intended use of combined androgen
blockade greater than 30 days from start of therapy; 4) prior adjuvant hormonal
therapy > 12 months vs. ≤12 months; 5) use of FDA approved drugs for delaying
skeletal related events; and 6) extent of disease: high volume vs. low volume
disease.
The method of permuted blocks will be used for subject randomization. No per-
site treatment-allocation balance will be implemented.
